messages.content: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership with local delivery companies announced.
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.
People around you are stressed: Patricia Hawkins, Rick Tanner. The mood is tense.

You heard directly from Tamika Jefferson (Car Salesperson): Send a brief, professional note to Angela Wright — not asking again about the stay bonus timeline, but signaling continued commitment and surface-level visibility. The message: acknowledge that the transition support resources she is coordinating are real and valued, and confirm that I remain fully engaged on the floor. This is not a follow-up about the $12,000. It is a presence signal. Angela is actively cross-referencing layoff lists against transition program enrollment. I want my name associated with 'staying and contributing,' not 'flight risk or passive.' One short, professional message. No questions, no asks.
